responses.reason: Accepted: the falling-entry cycle is included in the observed fall duration while using a 0-based counter, so the threshold must be >= 20 to splatter after more than 20 falling cycles.
responses.spec_quote: if a Lemming falls for more than 20 clock cycles then hits the ground, it will splatter and cease walking, falling, or digging (all 4 outputs become 0), forever
